svg.text: the runner pool, as eighteen dispatches saw it
the number in each box is the datapath probe's 512:256 ratio; only one machine reads 2
first, the probe on this VM: below 1.5, stop in a minute;
at 2, the four arms, about 74 minutes, and the file
records the reading the same VM produced
a miss costs a minute, a hit costs an hour - so dispatch until the pool
hands over the machine, and let the file prove which one it was
